title: VTA Collection — Settings — Set — payload
description: A client with administrative authority over a trust context enables or disables collection by default there: whether its VTA collects for the context's identifiers that no client has claimed (VTI-NTF-094, VTI-NTF-095). The VTA stores the setting, applies it before it answers — disabling it stops collection and closes the VTA's connections for those identifiers — and records the change in its audit trail (VTI-NTF-096). The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

contextId.description: The trust context whose setting to change. The change applies to that context's identifiers alone, not to its ancestors' or descendants' (VTI-NTF-094).

collectByDefault.description: true to enable collection by default for the context, false to disable it.

Response.title: VTA Collection — Settings — Set — response payload
Response.description: The context's setting once the change has taken effect.

changed.description: Whether this request changed the setting. False when the context already held the value asked for, in which case nothing changed but the record of the request (VTI-NTF-095).
